tasks.title: Develop Store Admin Module
tasks.description: Implement product and customer account management for store owners and sales personnel.

tasks.title: Develop Customer Storefront
tasks.description: Implement product browsing, shopping cart management, and order placement features.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user has an empty shopping cart
acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to submit the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system rejects the submission and does not create an order

source.quote: An empty cart cannot be submitted.

acceptance_criteria.given: the user is browsing the store without being signed in
acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to place an order
acceptance_criteria.then: the system forces the user to sign in before finalizing the order

source.quote: Customers may browse without signing in but must sign in before placing an order.
